content.title: Can I Shop at a Dispensary in Ohio? - Guaranteed Dispensary
content.text: Ohio has entered a new era with the legalization of adult-use cannabis, but the laws can still be confusing. Further, some of the terminology that has been used along the way has introduced even more confusion among OH residents who are trying to determine if they can visit a dispensary or not. One of the biggest questions we see is a basic one: can I shop at a dispensary in Ohio? While things can seem a bit confusing, shopping for cannabis as an adult is not as complicated as it may seem. Take a look at who can now shop at dispensaries in Ohio, as well as some other frequent questions new adult cannabis customers have below. Order Ahead So, who can shop at a dispensary in Ohio? If you’re 21 or older, you’re eligible to buy cannabis for adult use in Ohio. That’s it! No medical card or special permissions are needed; you only have to be a verifiable adult who can supply identification to prove you are at least 21 years of age or older. What do I need to bring to shop at dispensaries in Ohio? Simply, bring a valid driver’s license or state ID, passport, or military ID. This is to verify your age and identity, so we can ensure you meet the 21+ requirement. No other documentation is needed for adult-use purchases, and you can pay for your purchase in cash during the checkout process. What is an adult cannabis menu like? Is adult-use cannabis different from medical cannabis? For now, both menus have many of the same items because adult-geared cultivators and processors are still getting their operations going. However, there can be slight differences between what is available on the two menus. While both medical and adult-use menus share many products, medical patients may have access to a slightly broader selection, especially in terms of more potent or specialized products tailored to specific medical needs. Adult-use users have access to a wide variety of high-quality cannabis, just the same, though. What is nonmedical cannabis like? Nonmedical or adult-use cannabis in Ohio is much like other cannabis products. The adult menu includes the same types of cannabis products as medical: flower, edibles, concentrates, and topicals. The primary difference is the adult-use menu contains products that are more about personal enjoyment, whether for relaxation, creativity, or social fun, while the medical menu is more geared toward medicinal or therapeutic support for patients. How do you find dispensaries in Ohio that offer adult-use cannabis? When Ohio regulators finally passed the laws for nonmedical cannabis, they began approving some of the existing medical dispensaries for an adult-use license. This path was taken to allow adult customers to have access to high-quality cannabis as quickly as possible. Our dispensary, Guaranteed Dispensary in Dayton, is one of them! Therefore, while we still offer medical cannabis for patients, we can also now cater to adult customers who are 21 and up. Explore the Best Adult-Use Cannabis at Guaranteed Dispensary Hopefully, we’ve helped clear any confusion about adult-use cannabis and who is welcome to shop at dispensaries in Ohio. If you are ready to become an adult cannabis customer and still have questions, we’re here to help you every step of the way. Stop in at our Dayton dispensary where you will find an inviting environment with professionals ready to offer advice, answer questions, and show you the many products we have on the menu.
